mapper.select: /*selectBuyerWmGrWarehousingRegSlogic*/ SELECT X.BUYER , DECODE(Y.BUYER, NULL, 'N', 'Y') AS ROW_CNT_YN --그리드 행개수 , DECODE(Y.BUYER, NULL, 10, Y.ROW_CNT) AS ROW_CNT --그리드 default 개수 , DECODE(V.BUYER, NULL, 'N', 'Y') AS CARD_YN --신용카드 사용고객사 , NVL(W.DEPT_FIX, 'N') AS DEPT_FIX --요청부서 조건 고정 , NVL(W.PR_USER_FIX, 'N') AS PR_USER_FIX --요청자로 조건 고정 , NVL(W.PO_USER_FIX, 'N') AS PO_USER_FIX --발주자로 조건 고정 FROM ( SELECT #{com_code} BUYER -- SESSION COMCODE FROM DUAL ) X , ( /* SLOGIC-BEGIN(P07-0000004) 그리드 출력 초기 rowcount 100 (default rowcount 10) */ SELECT B.COM_CODE BUYER, B.COL01_DATA ROW_CNT FROM BNTSLGDEF A, BNTSLGIMP B WHERE 1=1 AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN A.OPEN_DATE AND A.CLOSE_DATE AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN B.OPEN_DATE AND B.CLOSE_DATE AND A.SLG_ID = B.SLG_ID AND A.SLG_ID = 'P07-0000004' /* SLOGIC-END */ ) Y , ( /* SLOGIC-BEGIN(P07-0000043) 신용카드사용 고객사 */ SELECT B.COM_CODE BUYER FROM BNTSLGDEF A, BNTSLGIMP B WHERE 1=1 AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN A.OPEN_DATE AND A.CLOSE_DATE AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN B.OPEN_DATE AND B.CLOSE_DATE AND A.SLG_ID = B.SLG_ID AND A.SLG_ID = 'P06-0000043' --<-- P07-0000006 : ID 대체 /* SLOGIC-END */ ) V , ( /* SLOGIC-BEGIN(P07-0000008) 조회조건 */ SELECT B.COM_CODE BUYER , B.COL01_DATA DEPT_FIX , B.COL02_DATA PR_USER_FIX , B.COL03_DATA PO_USER_FIX FROM BNTSLGDEF A, BNTSLGIMP B WHERE 1=1 AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN A.OPEN_DATE AND A.CLOSE_DATE AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN B.OPEN_DATE AND B.CLOSE_DATE AND A.SLG_ID = B.SLG_ID AND A.SLG_ID = 'P07-0000008' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 'X' FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = #{user_id} AND USER_TYPE = 'A') /* SLOGIC-END */ ) W WHERE X.BUYER = Y.BUYER(+) AND X.BUYER = V.BUYER(+) AND X.BUYER = W.BUYER(+)

mapper.update: /*insertBuyerWmGrWarehousingGrdt*/ INSERT INTO ICOMGRDT ( BUYER , GR_NO , GR_SEQ , STATUS , SEND_DATE , SEND_TIME , ADD_DATE , ADD_TIME , CHANGE_DATE , CHANGE_TIME , CONFIRM_DATE , CONFIRM_TIME , SELLER , GR_DATE , PAY_TERMS , USANCE_DAYS , BUYER_ITEM_NO , SELLER_ITEM_NO , DESCRIPTION , SPECIFICATION , CUR , UNIT_MEASURE , ITEM_QTY , UNIT_PRICE , ITEM_AMT , INV_NO , INV_SEQ , PO_NO , PO_SEQ , DO_NO , DO_SEQ , EXCHANGE_RATE , GR_LOC_AMT , LC_NO , AP_NO , PROCESS_TYPE , RO_QTY , ADD_USER_ID , NOTIFY , PAYER , PAYEE , GR_BAL_QTY , AGENT , AGENT_PRICE , CHANGE_USER_ID , AGENT_ITEM_AMT , LEGACY_PO_NO , LEGACY_PO_SEQ , BYIT_COMORG_CODE , REF_PR_NO ) ( SELECT D.BUYER , #{gr_no} , TO_CHAR(#{gr_seq},'FM000000') , 'C' , ' ' , ' ' , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') , ' ' , ' ' , D.SELLER , #{gr_date} , H.PAY_TERMS , H.USANCE_DAYS , D.BUYER_ITEM_NO , D.SELLER_ITEM_NO , D.DESCRIPTION , D.SPECIFICATION , H.CUR , D.UNIT_MEASURE , ${gr_qty} , T.UNIT_PRICE , ROUND(${gr_qty} * T.UNIT_PRICE) , D.INV_NO , D.INV_SEQ , D.PO_NO , D.PO_SEQ , D.DO_NO , D.DO_SEQ , '12' , '1' , D.LC_NO , '' , H.INV_TYPE , 0 , #{user_id} , D.NOTIFY , D.PAYER , D.PAYEE , ${gr_qty} , #{agent} , ${agent_price} , #{user_id} , ROUND(${gr_qty} * T.AGENT_PRICE) , T.LEGACY_PO_NO , T.LEGACY_PO_SEQ , T.BYIT_COMORG_CODE , #{gr_ref_pr_no} FROM ICOMIVDT D, ICOMIVHD H, ICOMPODT T WHERE D.BUYER = #{buyer} AND D.SELLER = #{seller} AND D.INV_NO = #{inv_no} AND D.INV_SEQ = #{inv_seq} AND D.STATUS != 'D' AND D.BUYER = H.BUYER AND D.SELLER = H.SELLER AND D.INV_NO = H.INV_NO AND D.BUYER = T.BUYER AND D.PO_NO = T.PO_NO AND D.PO_SEQ = T.PO_SEQ AND H.STATUS != 'D' )

/*insertBuyerWmGrWarehousingGrdt1*/ INSERT INTO ICOMGRDT ( BUYER , GR_NO , GR_SEQ , STATUS , SEND_DATE , SEND_TIME , ADD_DATE , ADD_TIME , CHANGE_DATE , CHANGE_TIME , CONFIRM_DATE , CONFIRM_TIME , SELLER , GR_DATE , PAY_TERMS , USANCE_DAYS , BUYER_ITEM_NO , SELLER_ITEM_NO , DESCRIPTION , SPECIFICATION , CUR , UNIT_MEASURE , ITEM_QTY , UNIT_PRICE , ITEM_AMT , INV_NO , INV_SEQ , PO_NO , PO_SEQ , DO_NO , DO_SEQ , EXCHANGE_RATE , GR_LOC_AMT , LC_NO , AP_NO , PROCESS_TYPE , RO_QTY , ADD_USER_ID , NOTIFY , PAYER , PAYEE , GR_BAL_QTY , AGENT , AGENT_PRICE , CHANGE_USER_ID , AGENT_ITEM_AMT , LEGACY_PO_NO , LEGACY_PO_SEQ , BYIT_COMORG_CODE , REF_PR_NO ) ( SELECT D.BUYER , #{gr_no} , TO_CHAR(#{gr_seq},'FM000000') , 'C' , ' ' , ' ' , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') , ' ' , ' ' , D.SELLER , #{gr_date} , H.PAY_TERMS , H.USANCE_DAYS , D.BUYER_ITEM_NO , D.SELLER_ITEM_NO , D.DESCRIPTION , D.SPECIFICATION , H.CUR , D.UNIT_MEASURE , ${gr_qty} , T.UNIT_PRICE , ROUND(${gr_qty} * T.UNIT_PRICE) , W.INV_NO , W.INV_SEQ , W.PO_NO , W.PO_SEQ , D.DO_NO , D.DO_SEQ , '12' --EXCHANGE_RATE , '1' --GR_LOC_AMT , D.LC_NO , '' , H.INV_TYPE , 0 , #{user_id} , D.NOTIFY , D.PAYER , D.PAYEE , ${gr_qty} , #{agent} , ${agent_price} , #{user_id} , ROUND(${gr_qty} * T.AGENT_PRICE) , T.LEGACY_PO_NO , T.LEGACY_PO_SEQ , T.BYIT_COMORG_CODE , #{gr_ref_pr_no} FROM ICOMIVDT D, ICOMIVHD H, ICOMPODT T, WMSIVDT W WHERE W.BUYER = #{buyer} AND W.SELLER = #{seller} AND W.INV_NO = #{inv_no} AND W.INV_SEQ = #{inv_seq} AND D.STATUS != 'D' AND D.BUYER = H.BUYER AND D.SELLER = H.SELLER AND D.INV_NO = H.INV_NO AND D.BUYER = W.BUYER AND D.INV_NO = W.S_INV_NO AND D.INV_SEQ = W.S_INV_SEQ AND D.BUYER = T.BUYER AND D.PO_NO = T.PO_NO AND D.PO_SEQ = T.PO_SEQ AND H.STATUS != 'D' )
mapper.select: /*selectBuyerWmGrWarehousingGrQtyCheck*/ SELECT (${gr_qty} + NVL(GR_QTY,0)) - NVL(INV_QTY,0) AS GR_QTY FROM ( SELECT --NVL(B.GR_QTY,0) AS GR_QTY -- 기입고수량 DECODE(B.PROCESS_TYPE,'0',NVL(C.GR_QTY, 0),NVL(D.BUYER_GR_QTY, 0)) AS GR_QTY -- 기입고수량 , DECODE(B.PROCESS_TYPE,'0',NVL(C.INV_QTY,0),NVL(D.INV_QTY,0)) AS INV_QTY -- 송장수량 FROM ICOMPODT B, ICOMIVDT C, WMSIVDT D WHERE B.BUYER = #{buyer} AND B.PO_NO = #{po_no} AND B.PO_SEQ = #{po_seq} AND DECODE(B.PROCESS_TYPE,'0',C.INV_NO,D.INV_NO) = #{inv_no} AND DECODE(B.PROCESS_TYPE,'0',C.INV_SEQ,D.INV_SEQ) = #{inv_seq} AND B.BUYER = C.BUYER AND B.PO_NO = C.PO_NO AND B.PO_SEQ = C.PO_SEQ AND C.BUYER = D.BUYER(+) AND C.INV_NO = D.S_INV_NO(+) AND C.INV_SEQ = D.S_INV_SEQ(+) AND D.STATUS(+) <> 'D' AND B.STATUS <> 'D' AND C.STATUS <> 'D' ) S
